title: Mediterranean Chicken Wraps
subtitle: with crunchy basil slaw & creamy tzatziki dip
description: These Mediterranean chicken wraps will take your taste buds on a real getaway! Whole wheat tortillas slathered with a crisp tzatziki, filled with yogurt marinated chicken, a crunchy basil, feta and sundried tomato slaw and fresh dill. Talk about perfection!

instructions.title: MARINATION STATION
instructions.text: Place the Spanish rub and 1/3 of the yoghurt in a bowl with a drizzle of oil and mix to combine. Add in the chicken mini fillets, toss to coat, and set aside to marinate.

instructions.title: ONION PERFECTION!
instructions.text: Place a pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the sliced onion for 8-9 minutes until soft and caramelised, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion, cover, and set aside to keep warm.

instructions.title: DREAMY TZATZIKI & SLAW
instructions.text: In a bowl combine the diced cucumber, 1/2 the chopped dill, the remaining yoghurt and 10ml of olive oil. Mix to combine, season and set aside. In a separate bowl, toss the shredded cabbage, drained crumbled feta, sun-dried tomatoes and basil pesto together, season to taste and set aside.

instructions.title: YOU'RE ALMOST THERE...
instructions.text: Place a nonstick pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the chicken mini fillets for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove from the heat on completion and set aside to rest for a few minutes.

instructions.title: HEAT THOSE WRAPS!
instructions.text: Place a clean pan over a medium heat. When hot, dry toast the tortillas one at a time for 30-60 seconds per side until heated and lightly crisped. Remove from the pan on completion.

instructions.title: LET'S WRAP IT UP!
instructions.text: Spread the tortilla with homemade tzatziki then fill with the mediterranean coleslaw, top with caramelised onions, chicken fillets and garnish with the remaining dill. Easy feasting!

chef_tip: Caramelised onions reach their full potential when sliced finely and cooked slowly. If you have the time, fry yours over a low heat for an extra 10-15 minutes.
